name: seshat
description: Publish, verify and update shareable artifacts with Seshat.

interface.longDescription: Publish reports, visualizations, documents and related files to a durable share link. Verify uploaded metadata, update existing artifacts and restore retained file or folder revisions. Requires Node.js 22 or newer, the Seshat CLI and a separately authorized Seshat profile. Uploads are public, unlisted links with optional passwords and expiration. Installing this skill does not grant publishing permission or connect an account.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report to Seshat and verify its share link.
Update my existing Seshat artifact without changing its link.
